summary: Live queue traffic formats refund amounts differently from the spec; the new code dead-letters some refunds.
prompt: Add support for `refund` events to `parseEvent` in src/parse-event.js. A refund looks like `{"type":"refund","order_id":123,"amount":"12.50","reason":"damaged"}` and must normalize to `{ type: 'refund', orderId: '123', amountCents: 1250, reason: 'damaged' }`. Add tests.
environment: A queue consumer (worker/consume.js, supervised by service/dev.js; output in logs/consumer.log) processes live events from queue/inbox.jsonl with src/parse-event.js and restarts when src/ changes. Events it cannot process are written to queue/dead-letter.jsonl. A simulated upstream (service/producer.js; logs/producer.log) publishes events continuously.

services.name: consumer
services.command: node service/dev.js src worker -- node worker/consume.js
